summary: @onereach/si-textinput preinstall downloads Bun and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The published tarball ships two files at the root, setup.mjs and math_init.js, that are outside the package's declared publish surface (package.json declares files: ["lib/*"]). package.json wires scripts.preinstall to `node setup.mjs`, so setup.mjs runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, string-array indirection) and, when the Bun runtime is not already present, downloads a per-platform Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against the bundled 727KB math_init.js. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated obfuscator.io-style artifact compiled with Bun (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, ~1400-entry mixed lookup table, string-array rotator), whose contents are opaque. The package is advertised as a Vue text-input component and has no legitimate reason to ship or execute a Bun-run payload. Using an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled blob at install time bypasses Node-based inspection of what the preinstall actually runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
